settings.title: Settings
settings.reasoningEffortHint: Reasoning effort for thinking models (low/medium/high/max, free input). Most thinking models default to high effort — low is faster and cheaper; unsupported values are dropped automatically on API 400
settings.reasoningOverrideHint: A JSON object merged into the LLM request body top-level, taking priority over the effort level above. For vendor-specific params, e.g. {"thinking": {"type": "disabled"}} or {"thinking_budget": 4000}
settings.reasoningOverrideInvalid: Must be a valid JSON object
settings.wikiModelRoutingHint: Assign dedicated models to different Wiki tasks. Leave empty to use the global model above
settings.wikiIngestModelHint: Wiki compile (deep understanding & page generation). A high-quality model is recommended
settings.wikiDedupModelHint: Duplicate page detection (JSON output; mid-tier capability suffices)
settings.wikiLedgerParseModelHint: Extracts ledger entries from compile material (lightweight structured output suffices). Leave empty to use global model
settings.wikiModelFallback: Leave empty to use global model
settings.systemPromptPlaceholder: You are a professional AI assistant...

internalModel.title: Local AI Models
internalModel.description: Local models required by the knowledge base. First-time download required.

concurrency.fileParsingHint: Number of files parsed simultaneously. Files are independent — multiple files of the same project are parsed in parallel. Default 2; increasing it requires an app restart
concurrency.imageDescriptionHint: Number of images described simultaneously. Each image is an independent VLM call. Default 2; increasing it requires an app restart
concurrency.compileHint: Number of Wiki compile tasks running simultaneously. Each task compiles one project, ingesting its files sequentially — this equals the number of projects compiled in parallel. Default 2; increasing it requires an app restart

llm.readTimeoutHint: Timeout for waiting model response, default 300s

task.title: Task Settings
task.modelHint: Leave empty to use global model. Stronger models recommended for coding tasks
task.plannerModelPlaceholder: Leave empty to skip planning phase
task.plannerModelHint: When set, enables dual-model architecture: planner analyzes first, then task model executes. Leave empty for single-model mode
task.timeoutHint: Maximum wait time for a single code/command execution, default 30s
task.maxIterationsHint: Maximum tool-call iterations per run, default 25; raise it for long workflows (e.g. workflow-skill driven tasks)
task.autoConfirmShellHint: Skip confirmation before running shell commands (advanced users)
task.shellConfirmSmart: Smart — Auto-approve safe commands, confirm others (Recommended)
task.shellConfirmModeHint: In smart mode, read-only commands like ls/cat/grep/git status are auto-approved; pip install/rm require confirmation
task.showLogHint: Display detailed tool call logs in the conversation flow
task.workspaceMaxMbHint: Maximum storage per task workspace, 0 = unlimited, default 1024MB
task.maxCountHint: Maximum number of tasks allowed, 0 = unlimited, default 50
task.autoArchiveDaysHint: Tasks not updated for N days are auto-archived, 0 = disabled, default 30
task.shellDomainWhitelistHint: One domain per line, e.g. pypi.org, github.com. In smart mode, network commands matching whitelisted domains are auto-approved
